corrections.from: An oxytocin recovery interval before caesarean delivery, 490 selves
corrections.finding: Two faults, and the item is otherwise whole and no duplicate. First, the body-mass-index figure reads as a main effect of body-mass index where the source holds it as a slope within a subgroup, and so reads the source backward. The item's clause runs "Each ten minutes longer in that interval goes with an estimated blood loss lower by 10 millilitres ... and with selves at a body-mass index of 40 or above lower by 45 millilitres, 71 to 20 lower, P < 0.001, at an interaction P of 0.004": the subject carried across the "and with" makes "selves at a body-mass index of 40 or above" the thing that is "lower by 45 millilitres". Two things in the item itself forbid that reading. An interaction P stands only between two slopes, so 45 millilitres is a per-ten-minutes lowering read within that subgroup and not a difference between subgroups; and the source's own direction for body-mass index runs the other way, its published abstract giving morbid obesity against a body-mass index under 40 as an estimated blood loss higher by 572 millilitres, 95% confidence interval 382 to 762, P < 0.001, so a self at a body-mass index of 40 or above standing "lower by 45 millilitres" inverts the field. The fix carries the per-ten-minutes frame into the subgroup clause and names no comparator the source does not hold: the interaction is against the item's own already-stated ten-minute slope of 10 millilitres, and the 572 figure stays out of the item, since the slice's source item cannot be read from its first eighty characters and gathering adds no number of its own. The bare "71 to 20 lower" also leaves its unit to carry across a clause boundary, and the unit goes back in, no number changed. Second, "goes with no difference in additional interventions, odds ratio 0.997, 95% confidence interval 0.959 to 1.036, P = 0.87" is a claim stronger than its measure: an interval spanning 1 is a measure not parting and is no observing of an equality. The field's own words are that the recovery interval, unlike the oxytocin amount and duration, was not associated with needing additional interventions, and the gathering-value file already holds the weaker idiom twice at this exact shape, "p = 0.200, no clear gain" and "with no clear benefit for deliberate self-harm, 0.60 (0.27 to 1.32)". Sound otherwise: 490 selves, 99 minutes with a standard deviation of 65, 6,447 milliunits with 6,868, 619 minutes with 355, 10 millilitres with 18 to 3 and P = 0.009, 0.997 with 0.959 to 1.036 and P = 0.87, and 1.004 per 100 milliunits with 1.001 to 1.008 and P = 0.005 each stand as the kind of measure it is, the interval written in the item's own "lower by" frame with its direction word on both bounds and in the source's own order, so no interval is inverted. The text holds no cause and no mechanism: "goes with" and "holds a mean of" carry every relation, and the pinching, starving, distressing and desensitizing of the living sentence it meets stay in that sentence and are not borrowed into the item. No source, name, publishing, session, date, narrator or history stands in it, and no dissolving word.

fixed.section: 1.4 A birth release — co-competency distributing the peak
fixed.sentence: A frame's move raises a volatility, and a physiology shows it: forcing with synchronized drive — contractions too strong and too frequent — pinches an emanation with a crest, starves a neutral, distresses a baby, and desensitizes a coupling's own recursioning, a forced coupling stalls and cascades.
fixed.text: Of 490 selves whose labour is augmented with oxytocin and who come to caesarean delivery for labour arrest, the interval between the oxytocin stopping and the delivery holds a mean of 99 minutes with a standard deviation of 65, the augmenting amount a mean of 6,447 milliunits with a standard deviation of 6,868, and its duration a mean of 619 minutes with a standard deviation of 355. Each ten minutes longer in that interval goes with an estimated blood loss lower by 10 millilitres, 95% confidence interval 18 to 3 millilitres lower, P = 0.009; among selves at a body-mass index of 40 or above each ten minutes longer goes with an estimated blood loss lower by 45 millilitres, 95% confidence interval 71 to 20 millilitres lower, P < 0.001, at an interaction P of 0.004. The interval goes with no clear difference in additional interventions, odds ratio 0.997, 95% confidence interval 0.959 to 1.036, P = 0.87, while each 100 milliunits of the total oxytocin goes with an odds ratio of 1.004 for those interventions, 1.001 to 1.008, P = 0.005.
